title: Prompt Capability Profile
description: A versioned record of semantic capabilities provided by one canonical prompt.

profile_version.description: Sequential version number for this prompt's profile history

profile_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of this complete profile for integrity verification

canonical_prompt_hash.description: Hash binding this profile to the exact canonical prompt record

acceptance_commit.description: Git commit SHA where this profile was accepted

direct_assignments.description: Capabilities directly owned by this prompt's canonical body

capability_id.description: Stable capability identifier from the catalog

presence.description: Level of capability presence in this prompt

capability_relation.description: How this prompt relates to the capability

evidence_refs.description: Repository proof references for material assignments

inherited_sources.description: Versioned shared policy/compiler sources this profile inherits from

source_id.description: Stable identifier for the inherited source

source_hash.description: Content hash of the inherited source for integrity

semantic_dependency_fingerprint.description: SHA256 of combined direct + inherited semantic dependencies

evidence_refs.description: Repository-owned proof references for this profile

prior_profile_ref.description: Reference to previous profile version (required when profile_version > 1)
